- Volume: ingest ~50k docs initially, avg doc length ~800 tokens. Peak query QPS ~10-20, bursty. Latency target: 150-300ms for search endpoint (including vector DB + rerank).
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget, wants predictable per-month cost. Interested in batching advice and embedding size tradeoffs. "We care about cost more than 1% quality bump."

- Integration questions: sample Node/TS SDK examples, recommended pipeline with Pinecone/Weaviate, schema for metadata + retrieval params, how to store vectors and handle updates. Concerned about cold-cache latency and KV/prefix caching options.
- Security: SSO for admin console (SAML), audit logs for API usage; not air-gapped. No strict data residency yet — US region preferred.
